## 2026-09-23 — Q8.6: Field registry and entity types

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable — same shared-field-registry shape
every prior domain used.

**Answer:** 9 domain-owned fields across 2 entity types (Agent, Agent
Run). Resource ID, Cost Center Tag, Environment reused unchanged from
Infrastructure; Owning Team reused from Roles & Departments. Sandbox
Tested Flag is the field-level resolution of cross-cutting/
sandbox-activation.md's Primary Uses — required whenever an Agent carries
a Production-scoped grant.
